Babar Azam Gifts Signed Bat to King Charles III

Pakistan cricket captain Babar Azam presented a signed bat to King Charles III. The presentation occurred during Pakistan's tour of England. The event gained attention, with King Charles reportedly asking if the bat was made of Pakistani willow. This interaction was captured on video and shared widely.
